entries.translation: Atu sarittah tan maagaxxi. Atu isillih quuktah tan qaada.
entries.note: Broad Afar form; native review required.

entries.translation: Уара иушәҵәо астиль. Уара иуцу акультура.
entries.transliteration: Uara iušəc̄o astil’. Uara iucu akul’tura.
entries.note: Masculine singular; standard loan nouns; native review required.

entries.translation: Styl wat jy dra. Kultuur wat jy saamdra.
entries.note: Informal singular; saamdra conveys carrying within or along.

entries.translation: Atadehyɛ a wohyɛ. Amammerɛ a wosoa.
entries.note: ISO ak represented through explicitly labeled Asante Twi; other Akan varieties require separate review.

entries.translation: Stili që ti vesh. Kultura që ti mbart.
entries.note: Informal singular; explicit ti prevents subject ambiguity.

entries.translation: የሚለብሱት ዘይቤ። የሚሸከሙት ባህል።
entries.note: Polite or plural generic you; native copy review advised.

entries.translation: أسلوب ترتديه. ثقافة تحملها معك.
entries.note: Modern Standard Arabic; generic masculine singular.

entries.translation: O estilo que vistes. A cultura que portas.
entries.note: Standard Aragonese; native review advised.

entries.translation: Ոճ, որ կրում ես։ Մշակույթ, որ կրում ես։
entries.transliteration: Voch, vor krum es. Mshakuyt, vor krum es.
entries.note: Eastern Armenian; the same verb creates native wordplay.

entries.translation: আপুনি পিন্ধা শৈলী। আপুনি কঢ়িয়াই নিয়া সংস্কৃতি।
entries.transliteration: Āpuni pindhā śailī. Āpuni kaṛhiyāi niyā saṃskṛti.
entries.note: Formal singular; balanced participial clauses.

entries.translation: Нужеца ретӀунеб къагӀида. Нужеца баччулеб маданият.
entries.transliteration: Nužeca ret’uneb qag’ida. Nužeca baččuleb madanijat.
entries.note: Polite or plural; native lexemes used; native review advised.

entries.translation: 𐬗𐬌𐬚𐬭𐬆𐬨 𐬫𐬀𐬝 𐬬𐬀𐬯𐬙𐬈. 𐬛𐬀𐬉𐬥𐬁 𐬫𐬄𐬨 𐬠𐬀𐬭𐬀𐬌𐬙𐬌.
entries.transliteration: ciθrəm yaṱ vaste. daēnā yąm baraiti.
entries.note: Scholarly reconstruction using generic one; culture approximated by daēnā; expert philological review mandatory.

entries.translation: Estilo ukax isimp isthapt’atawa. Sarawi ukax jumamp chika apt’atawa.
entries.note: Bolivian unified orthography; sarawi means lived cultural practice; native review required.

entries.translation: Geyindiyin üslub. Daşıdığın mədəniyyət.
entries.note: Informal singular; concise native syntax.

entries.translation: Һин кейгән стиль. Һин йөрөткән мәҙәниәт.
entries.transliteration: Hin keygän stil’. Hin yörötkän mäźäniät.
entries.note: Informal singular; established loan nouns; native copy review advised.

entries.translation: Cogo min na i bɛ fini don. Laada min b’i ta n’i ye.
entries.note: Style transcreated as way of dressing and culture as tradition; native review required.

entries.translation: Janzten duzun estiloa. Zurekin daramazun kultura.
entries.note: Neutral singular; daramazun means carrying with you.

entries.translation: Стыль, які носіш. Культура, якую нясеш.
entries.transliteration: Styĺ, jaki nosiš. Kuĺtura, jakuju niasieš.
entries.note: Informal singular; distinct wear and carry verbs.

entries.translation: যে শৈলী তুমি পরো। যে সংস্কৃতি তুমি বহন করো।
entries.transliteration: Je śailī tumi paro. Je saṃskṛti tumi bahan karo.
entries.note: Informal singular; exact balanced relative clauses.

entries.translation: Stael we yu werem. Kastom we yu karem.
entries.note: Kastom conveys lived culture and heritage.

entries.translation: Stil koji nosiš. Kultura koju nosiš.
entries.note: Informal singular; the same verb creates native wordplay.

entries.translation: Ar stil a wiskez. Ar sevenadur a zougez.
entries.note: Informal singular; expected relative-clause mutations; native review advised.

entries.translation: Стилът, който носиш. Културата, която носиш.
entries.transliteration: Stilǎt, kojto nosiš. Kulturata, kojato nosiš.
entries.note: Informal singular; носиш naturally carries both senses.

entries.nativeName: မြန်မာဘာသာ
entries.translation: သင်ဝတ်ဆင်သည့် ဟန်ပန်။ သင်သယ်ဆောင်သည့် ယဉ်ကျေးမှု။
entries.transliteration: Thin wut hsin thi han pan. Thin thae hsaung thi yin kyae hmu.
entries.note: Literary and formal register; native copy review advised.

entries.translation: L’estil que portes. La cultura que portes dins.
entries.note: Cross-variety wording; dins makes the embodied sense explicit.

entries.translation: I estilu ni’ un usa. I kuttura ni’ un chule’ gi halom-mu.
entries.note: Guam CHamoru orthography; established Hispanic loans; native review required.

entries.translation: Ахь лелош йолу стиль. Ахь хьайца дӀакхоьхьуш йолу культура.
entries.transliteration: Aẋ leloš yolu stil’. Aẋ ẋayca d’aqöẋuš yolu kul’tura.
entries.note: Informal singular; established loans; native review required.

entries.translation: 风格穿在身上，文化带在心中。
entries.transliteration: Fēnggé chuān zài shēnshang, wénhuà dài zài xīnzhōng.
entries.note: Simplified standard Mandarin; idiomatic balanced transcreation.

entries.translation: Ѡбразъ, єгоже носиши. Преданіе, єже въ себѣ носиши.
entries.transliteration: Obrazŭ, jegože nosiši. Predanije, ježe vŭ sebě nosiši.
entries.note: Russian recension; culture transcreated as tradition; expert liturgical-language review mandatory.

entries.translation: Эсӗ тӑхӑнакан стиль. Эсӗ илсе ҫӳрекен культура.
entries.transliteration: Esĕ tăhănakan stil’. Esĕ ilse çüreken kul’tura.
entries.note: Informal singular; established loans; native review advised.

entries.translation: An gis a wiskydh. An gonisogeth a dhegedh.
entries.note: Standard Written Form; gis is native style or fashion; native review advised.
